data.description: Initial data for the tensor. Can be a list, tuple, NumPy ``ndarray``, scalar, and other types.

device.description: the device of the constructed tensor. If None and data is a tensor then the device of data is used. If None and data is not a tensor then the result tensor is constructed on the current device.

requires_grad.description: If autograd should record operations on the returned tensor. Default: ``False``.

pin_memory.description: If set, returned tensor would be allocated in the pinned memory. Works only for CPU tensors. Default: ``False``.
